run_relax_atoms: run a relaxation on ASE atoms using the FIRE optimizer with a custom fmax threshold
run_relax_atoms_with_symmetry: run a relaxation on ASE atoms with fix_symmetry enabled to preserve structural symmetry
run_relax_atoms_with_cell_filter: run a relaxation on ASE atoms using a cell filter class to relax cell parameters
run_relax_atoms_with_observers: run a relaxation on ASE atoms with observer callbacks attached at a specified interval
run_relax_atoms_with_custom_optimizer: run a relaxation on ASE atoms using a custom ASE optimizer class instead of FIRE
